subject: English
question_text: Answering the following questions to write a paragraph on "Environment Pollution". You should write it in about
stimulus: 150 words : 10 (a) What is environment and what do you mean by environment pollution? (b) How is environment polluted? (c) What are the effects of environment pollution? (d) How can we save our environment from pollution? (e) Why is a healthy environment necessary for all?
source: SSC English 1st-paper Exclusive Model Test 03 (Made Easy Model)
